concerns.text: Tasks explicitly reject the dependency-pinning scaffolding task ('the platform supplies packages'), but the project constitution's Reproducibility Requirements NON-NEGOTIABLY mandate 'A requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at projects/.../code/ pins every Python dependency' and that the Code-Execution Agent builds an isolated virtualenv from it. No task produces this file — a constitution violation introduced by the task list.

Plan Phase 4 task 'Generate and record artifact hashes in state/ map' (Constitution Principle V versioning discipline; also Data Hygiene 'Every file under data/ is checksummed in state/... artifact_hashes map') has no corresponding task. T001 records a SHA-256 of the raw file in data/metadata.json, but no task updates the project state file's artifact_hashes/updated_at, so the constitutional versioning requirement is silently dropped.

Plan Phase 0 task 'Run Reference-Validator Agent on all citations' (Constitution Principle II gate, listed under 'Violations Addressed' as an added compliance task) has no corresponding task in tasks.md; citation-validation evidence is claimed in the plan but nothing in the task list produces it.

Plan states the mask uses 'the official Pantheon+ selection function', but T003 defines the mask as 'pixels with count > 0' (occupancy mask). The mask directly determines the MASTER correction and the null distribution; the task silently narrows the plan-mandated mask definition with no reconciliation or documented supersession.

SC-001 requires 'the fraction of supernovae successfully mapped to the HEALPix grid... measured against the total valid supernovae'. The coverage table claims T003/T007 satisfy this by 'reporting n_supernovae_used vs filtered total', but neither task's deliverable computes or records a mapping fraction artifact; the acceptance criterion is only partially carried into a task verification step.

T006 (systematics quantification, cross-calibration metadata) traces only to 'Marie Curie reviewer concern', not to any FR or plan section; the plan's 'Violations Addressed' explicitly removed unbacked tasks. Either cite the plan/reviewer record that authorizes this scope or note the plan-level authorization explicitly, so the work is not an unbacked addition.
